characterVersions.summaryIntro: An overview of Goku’s timelines, with their available sagas and summaries.
characterVersions.previewPilafStory: Still a child, Goku leaves his mountain with Bulma to find the Dragon Balls. Their journey brings him face to face with Pilaf and introduces him to a world far beyond his valley.
characterVersions.previewPiccoloJuniorStory: Now grown, Goku reunites with his friends at the Tenkaichi Budokai. He faces Piccolo Jr. and chooses to spare him, beginning a new chapter in their rivalry.
characterVersions.previewSaiyanStory: Raditz reveals Goku’s Saiyan origins. After sacrificing himself to stop his brother, Goku trains with King Kai and confronts the Saiyans threatening Earth.
characterVersions.previewMajinBuuStory: Returning for the Tenkaichi Budokai, Goku is caught up in Majin Buu’s awakening. He reveals Super Saiyan 3 and buys time for the next generation to defend Earth.
characterVersions.previewBuuStoryBeforeYakon: At the Tenkaichi Budokai, Goku reunites with his family and friends after seven years in the afterlife. Events soon take him to Babidi’s spaceship, where the fighters’ energy is measured to awaken Majin Buu.
characterVersions.previewBuuStoryAfterYakon: After the confrontation, Goku realizes Vegeta deliberately let Babidi control him. Their duel distracts from Buu’s awakening, but cannot prevent it. Later, Goku reveals Super Saiyan 3 to Buu and the children, then returns to the afterlife and leaves the next generation to act.
characterVersions.previewBuuStoryAfterVegeta: The duel ends when Goku agrees to stop so Vegeta will not endanger innocent people. Later, facing Buu, he reveals Super Saiyan 3 to the children. He then returns to the afterlife and leaves the next generation to act.
characterVersions.previewBuuStoryBeforeKidBuu: When Goku returns to Earth, the threat has changed form. With Vegeta, he tries to stop Buu while their allies look for a chance to turn the tide.
characterVersions.previewBuuStoryAfterKidBuu: The Genki-dama can only be launched with help from Vegeta, Mr. Satan, and Earth’s inhabitants. Once the energy is gathered, Goku defeats Buu and protects the planet.
characterVersions.previewBuuAnecdoteOne: Goku temporarily returns to the living world to enter the tournament and see his loved ones. The day takes a different turn when the fighters’ energy draws Babidi’s men.
characterVersions.previewBuuAnecdoteTwo: Super Saiyan 3 is first revealed during this saga. Goku later explains that the form consumes a great deal of energy, limiting the time he can spend among the living.
characterVersions.previewBuuAnecdoteThree: The conclusion does not depend on Goku alone: energy shared by Earth’s inhabitants forms the Genki-dama that ends the battle against Buu.
characterVersions.previewBuuNameOrigin: Son Goku (孫悟空) uses the Japanese reading of Sun Wukong’s name, the Monkey King from the Chinese tale Journey to the West.
characterVersions.previewCreditsScope: These cards connect notable fights with the animation supervision credits for their episodes. The ending credits name episode-level teams; they do not identify who animated each individual shot. Images illustrate the episodes, not the credited staff.
characterVersions.previewCreditBuu: Goku reveals Super Saiyan 3 against Buu
characterVersions.previewCreditArtAlt: Illustration from Dragon Ball Z episode {episode}
characterVersions.previewBuuDemoNotice: Layout example — demonstration content to review and complete in the dashboard.
characterVersions.previewBattleOfGodsStory: Meeting Beerus leads Goku to discover Super Saiyan God. He faces the God of Destruction and enters a world where divine ki can be reached.
characterVersions.previewTournamentOfPowerStory: At the Tournament of Power, Goku fights for Universe 7’s survival. Against the strongest opponents, he gradually awakens Ultra Instinct.
characterVersions.previewBabyStory: Turned into a child by the Dragon Balls, Goku travels through space with Pan and Trunks. His battle against Baby pushes him to Super Saiyan 4.
characterVersions.previewShadowDragonsStory: The repeated use of the Dragon Balls brings forth the Shadow Dragons. Goku and Vegeta join forces as Super Saiyan 4 against Omega Shenron.
characterVersions.previewDaimaStory: Turned small by Gomah’s conspiracy, Goku and his companions set off on an adventure in the Demon Realm.
